text:
devon: heads up — PR 17321 is ready for final merge but needs cross-team signoff. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/17321. Changes: tweak eviction header, introduce `evict_on_low_mem` toggle, and route fallback to quantized model when mem < 8GB. Targeting Wed 09:00 PST merge window. Can runtime + infra + security please quick-eyes?

maria: pinging runtime owners @alex and @devon. quick perf note: i ran local perf with a 512-token sequence and saw ~3% p99 increase on a small sample. not a blocker but worth checking.

alex: thanks — will run full perf suite on staging today. devon can you drop the exact job/config you used? also does this change affect continuous batching behavior?

devon: job config is `evict-read-heavy.json` in the PR. sample command: `./tools/loadtest --profile=evict-read-heavy --duration=5m`. change only toggles when we decide to evict prefixes early; batching logic unchanged but routing may pick quantized variant more often.

jen-sre: from SRE side, can you confirm there are no new Prom counters to backfill? if this changes eviction frequency we should add `eviction.attempts` and `eviction.fallback_quantized` metrics. If not in this PR, add a follow-up ticket.

devon: good call. i'll add minimal counters in this PR — two new metrics: `eviction_attempts_total` and `eviction_quantized_fallback_total`. adding now.

secops-bot: security-scan: no high severity findings. quick note: KMS usage updated to include `encrypt_then_cache` flow. please ensure key rotation docs updated.

maria: sec ok from my quick read but @devon pls add a short blurb about key usage in the PR description for auditors.

ci-bot: CI passed — unit: ✅ integration: ✅ smoke: ✅ staging-deploy: pending (queued).

alex: i'll own perf signoff. expecting results in ~2h. if no regressions i'll drop an approval. pls hold merge until jen-sre confirms metric addition or a follow-up ticket is filed.

devon: noted. i'll wait for perf + SRE ok. thanks all :pray:
